title: Joyalukkas Exchange Brings Convenience to Al Maskaan Village and Khazaen City
excerpt: Al Maskaan Village, the innovative worker accommodation community in Khazaen Economic City, is pleased to announce a partnership with Joyalukkas Exchange LLC. This collaboration brings a dedicated…

blocks.text: Al Maskaan Village, the innovative worker accommodation community in Khazaen Economic City, is pleased to announce a partnership with Joyalukkas Exchange LLC. This collaboration brings a dedicated Joyalukkas Exchange Customer Service Center directly to Al Maskaan Village, enhancing convenience and financial security for both residents and the wider Khazaen City community.
By offering these essential financial services on-site, Al Maskaan Village reinforces its commitment to providing a comfortable, convenient, and supportive living environment for its residents.

items: Hassle-Free Remittance Services: Choose from a variety of ways to send money abroad, including bank transfers, cash pickups, and mobile wallets. Whether you visit a branch or use our online platform, simply provide the details and we’ll handle the rest – with real-time tracking available.

Secure Online Money Transfer Services: Enjoy competitive exchange rates and flexible transfer methods, including Telegraphic Transfers and SWIFT options. Whether for personal or business needs, Joyalukkas Exchange is here to assist every step of the way.

Instant Money Transfer: Easily send money worldwide with Joyalukkas Exchange, a trusted Western Union partner. Access over 200,000 locations for quick transfers or choose bank deposits in almost all countries. We also partner with Money Gram TransFast, Ezremit, and Instant Cash for even more options.

Inward Remittance: Receive money from anywhere in the world securely. Whether supporting loved ones or covering personal expenses, we make collecting money in Oman simple and convenient, with fast, secure, and transparent services to ensure your funds are in safe hands.
Inter-Branch Transfers: Transferring money between different branches is now easier than ever. Our advanced network ensures quick, smooth, and secure transfers within our extensive branch network.
International Utility Payments: Pay your utility bills conveniently at any of our branches.

Mobile Top-Up: Stay connected with our user-friendly mobile top-up service. Recharge your prepaid mobile plans instantly, securely, and hassle-free. Our domestic and international mobile top-up service allows you to top off your mobile phone credit with ease, no matter where you are.

Foreign Currency Exchange: Convert your local currency into a variety of foreign currencies at highly competitive rates. Whether for travel or international business, our seamless process ensures you get the currency you need for hassle-free transactions.
Foreign Currency Converter: Access competitive foreign currency exchange rates with our user-friendly converter, providing favorable rates across a wide range of currencies.

blocks.text: Setting a New Standard for Worker Accommodation and Tenant Experience

This partnership underscores Al Maskaan Village’s dedication to resident well-being and its goal of creating a self-contained, supportive community. By offering on-site financial solutions through Joyalukkas Exchange, Al Maskaan Village, along with Khazaen City, aims to set a new standard for worker accommodation and tenant experience, prioritizing comfort, convenience, and financial security for all residents and tenants.

title: Bank Muscat ATM Now Active
excerpt: Residents of Al Maskaan Village can now enjoy seamless access to banking services right within their community, with the recent activation of a Bank Muscat ATM.

blocks.text: Enhancing Convenience for Residents
Residents of Al Maskaan Village can now enjoy seamless access to banking services right within their community, with the recent activation of a Bank Muscat ATM.
This new addition provides a range of convenient banking options, including cash withdrawals, balance inquiries, and other essential services, all easily accessible to Al Maskaan Village residents.

The installation of the Bank Muscat ATM at Al Maskaan Village reflects the ongoing commitment to enriching the living experience within the community. Meeting the financial needs of residents and providing them with essential amenities closer to home, this ATM is set to be a valuable addition to daily life.

“We are excited to announce that the Bank Muscat ATM is now active at Al Maskaan Village,” said Mr. Ryan Maxwell, Business Development Manager at Al Maskaan Village. “This addition is a testament to our dedication to making residents’ lives easier by bringing convenient services to their doorstep. We are confident that this ATM will enhance the overall lifestyle and convenience of our residents.”

Bank Muscat, Oman’s leading financial institution, continues to expand its reach, with over 174 branches and more than 800 ATMs, CDMs, and FFMs throughout Oman. With a customer base exceeding 2 million, Bank Muscat is known for its commitment to service excellence and customer convenience, providing residents and businesses alike with easy access to their finances and a trusted banking experience.

Al Maskaan Village continues to grow as a dynamic financial hub within Khazaen City. We extend an open invitation to banks, investment firms, and other financial services to join us in creating a vibrant financial destination. title: Oman’s Thriving Market and Logistics Landscape: A Look at Khazaen City
excerpt: Oman’s strategic location and economic development make it a fascinating spot for businesses looking to expand. Here’s a breakdown of Oman’s market, logistics sector, and the up-and-coming Khazaen…

blocks.text: Oman’s strategic location and economic development make it a fascinating spot for businesses looking to expand. Here’s a breakdown of Oman’s market, logistics sector, and the up-and-coming Khazaen City:

Oman’s Market: A Gateway to Growth – Strategic Location: Oman sits at the crossroads of major trade routes, connecting Asia, Africa, and Europe. This prime position makes it an attractive hub for international trade.
– Economic Diversification: The Omani government is actively reducing its reliance on oil and gas. This diversification plan fosters growth in sectors like tourism, manufacturing, and logistics.
– Modern Infrastructure: Oman boasts a well-developed network of ports, roads, and airports, facilitating efficient movement of goods.
– Open for Business: The Omani government welcomes foreign investment, offering incentives and simplifying the business setup process.
Oman Logistics: Gearing Up for Success – Government Support: The Omani government invests heavily in logistics infrastructure, creating a robust ecosystem for businesses.
– Free Trade Agreements: Oman has free trade agreements with several countries, reducing trade barriers and making it a cost-effective export base.
– Growing Demand: The e-commerce boom and increasing regional trade fuel demand for efficient logistics solutions in Oman.
– Skilled Workforce: Oman has a growing pool of skilled logistics professionals to support the industry’s needs.
Khazaen City: A Logistics Hub in the Making – Strategic Location: Khazaen City is a large-scale development project strategically located near Muscat and major transportation links.
– Focus on Logistics: The city is designed to be a major logistics hub, offering warehousing, distribution centers, and other logistics facilities.
– Free Zone Advantage: Companies operating in Khazaen benefit from free zone status, including tax exemptions and streamlined customs procedures.
– Investment Magnet: Khazaen City is attracting significant investment from international logistics companies, further boosting its importance.
The Future is Bright

Oman’s market offers exciting opportunities for businesses, and its logistics sector is well-positioned to handle future growth. With developments like Khazaen City, Oman is solidifying its place as a key player in the global trade landscape.

title: Al Maskaan Village: Your Gateway to Thriving Khazaen
excerpt: Exciting developments are unfolding right here in Khazaen Economic City, and Al Maskaan Village is proud to be a part of this vibrant ecosystem!

blocks.text: Exciting developments are unfolding right here in Khazaen Economic City, and Al Maskaan Village is proud to be a part of this vibrant ecosystem!

Welcome FLAG Logistics! We’re thrilled to welcome FLAG Logistics, a state-of-the-art logistics hub launched by GWC QPSC, to Khazaen Economic City. This first-of-its-kind facility boasts a modern 50,000 sqm infrastructure, offering a wide range of services including dry, chilled, and frozen storage, bulk storage, and more. Strategically located for seamless connections across the GCC and beyond, FLAG promises to be a game-changer for Oman’s logistics sector.

Welcome Wakud! A joint venture between Carbon Management Services LLC, Green Fuels, and Maher Al Habsi. Wakud is building a biofuel ecosystem in the Middle East, starting with Oman. Their state-of-the-art plant located in Muscat aims to catalyze the biofuel market with high-quality fuels produced from waste products, supporting decarbonization efforts.

And Welcome Silal: Oman’s Fruit & Vegetable Hub Arrives! Adding to the buzz is Silal, Oman’s brand new Fruits & Vegetables Central Market. This state-of-the-art facility integrates warehousing, distribution, and logistics under one roof, offering a significant upgrade from the previous Al Mawaleh market. Silal will serve as a central hub for all things fresh produce, bringing together importers, exporters, wholesalers, retailers, and consumers in a modern and efficient space.

title: Al Maskaan Village Partners with Trufud to Bolster Oman’s Food Security and Vision 2040 Goals
excerpt: In a move that significantly contributes to Oman’s food security goals outlined in Vision 2040, Al Maskaan Village has signed a strategic agreement with Trufud, Oman’s largest indoor vertical farm.…

blocks.text: In a move that significantly contributes to Oman’s food security goals outlined in Vision 2040, Al Maskaan Village has signed a strategic agreement with Trufud, Oman’s largest indoor vertical farm. This partnership ensures a steady supply of fresh, organic leafy vegetables for both Al Maskaan Village residents and, more specifically, Al Maskaan Catering.

Supporting Local, Sustainable Food Production: This collaboration between Al Maskaan Village and Trufud goes beyond simply securing a reliable source of vegetables. It signifies a commitment to supporting Oman’s vision for a self-sufficient and sustainable food system. Trufud’s innovative indoor farming techniques use significantly less water and land compared to traditional agriculture, making them a perfect partner for AMV’s environmentally conscious approach.

Fresh, Organic Produce for a Healthy Community: Residents of Al Maskaan Village can now enjoy the benefits of having access to fresh, locally-grown, and organic vegetables. AL Maskaan Catering will also benefit from this partnership, incorporating high-quality ingredients into their culinary creations.

"We are thrilled to partner with Trufud," said Ryan Maxwell, Business Development Manager at Al Maskaan Village. "This agreement aligns perfectly with our vision of creating a sustainable and healthy community. By supporting Trufud’s innovative farming methods, we are not only ensuring a steady supply of fresh produce for our residents and catering service, but also contributing to Oman’s food security goals."

This partnership between Al Maskaan Village and Trufud is a prime example of how businesses can collaborate to create a positive impact on Oman’s economy, environment, and overall well-being. By supporting local, sustainable agriculture, Al Maskaan Village is paving the way for a more secure and healthy future for the Sultanate.

title: Exciting Partnership Announcement!
excerpt: Al Maskaan Village, an innovative worker accommodation community set to open its doors by June 2024 within Khazaen Economic City, announces its collaboration with Joyalukkas Exchange LLC, a leading…

blocks.text: Al Maskaan Village, an innovative worker accommodation community set to open its doors by June 2024 within Khazaen Economic City, announces its collaboration with Joyalukkas Exchange LLC, a leading provider of secure and convenient financial services.
Partnership Inauguration

Together, they announced their partnership through the inauguration of a Joyalukkas Exchange branch, the 44th in Oman, at Al Maskaan Village. This collaboration aims to provide residents with essential financial solutions right at their doorstep.
Commitment to Resident Comfort and Convenience

Dr. Aadil Alexander, Executive Director at Al Maskaan Village, emphasized the commitment to offering comfort and convenience to residents. He stated, "Simplifying their financial lives is integral to this commitment." The presence of a Joyalukkas Exchange branch within Al Maskaan Village ensures residents have access to a trusted partner for various financial transactions, including money transfers, foreign currency exchange, and more, all conveniently located within the community’s retail spaces.
Effortless Financial Solutions

With a dedicated service desk established within Al Maskaan Village, Joyalukkas Exchange leverages its extensive experience and network to offer residents and visitors effortless remittances, simplified currency exchange, and streamlined bill payments. Moreover, residents can benefit from excellent exchange rates and services along with special promotions.
Alignment of Vision

Mr. Nixon Baby, General Manager at Joyalukkas Exchange LLC, expressed excitement about the partnership, stating, "We’re thrilled to join forces with Al Maskaan Village and become an integral part of their vibrant community." He emphasized the alignment of their customer-centric approach and efficient service with Al Maskaan Village’s vision, aiming to provide unparalleled convenience and peace of mind for residents’ financial needs.
Setting a New Standard

Mr. Ryan Maxwell, Business Development Manager at Al Maskaan Village, highlighted that this partnership reflects their dedication to resident well-being and their commitment to fostering a self-contained and supportive community. By adding Joyalukkas Exchange to their network of partners, Al Maskaan Village aims to set a new standard for worker accommodation in Oman, prioritizing residents’ comfort, convenience, and financial security.
The signing of this partnership took place at Aloft Hotel, Muscat, further cementing the collaboration between the two entities.

"A Haven of Five" pillars define Al Maskaan Village—more than accommodations, it’s a commitment to a lifestyle where quality meets warmth, and community thrives. We take pride in creating not just a place to live, but a genuine sense of belonging and a journey towards excellence.
